表面应优先呈现玻璃质感，边框、阴影与模糊仅用于强化这一材质选择。
技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 1px padding and a 999px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(247, 241, 231, 0.28), rgba(247, 241, 231, 0.07) 48%, rgba(95, 140, 255, 0.16)) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• keep spacing aligned to the detected 6px rhythm.
• 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。
• keep corner radii within the detected 10px, 18px, 22px, 33px, 34px, 999px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 不要exceed the detected moderate motion intensity without a deliberate reason.
动效
动效克制且以界面为主导，贯穿文字、布局与区块过渡。 时序主要聚集在 250ms 与 280ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。

WebGL
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a full-bleed background field using webgl, renderer, alpha, DPR 限制, custom shaders. The effect should read as technical, meditative, and atmospheric: fine line lattice with black and sparse spacing. Build it from line trails + sparse anchors so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve reduced motion + dom fallback.

三维引擎
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the 三维引擎 layer as a full-bleed background field 与层叠空间纵深 that feels technical. Use alpha, DPR 限制 renderer settings, orthographic projection, plane geometry, shadermaterial materials, and 环境光 + 主光 + 轮廓光 lighting. Motion should read as slow orbital drift, with reduced motion + non-3d fallback.
